body.statement: For the one-proxy graph in Figure 3 of Tramontano et al. (2025), the causal target in their Theorem 3.5 is the structural coefficient on the directed edge from the observed treatment \(T\) to the observed outcome \(Y\), denoted there by \(b_{Y,T}\).

attestation.note: Checked against the PMLR source-of-record PDF; the node paraphrases the target notation and graph location rather than claiming a verbatim transcription.
